units.source_text: 穿过寂静得几乎连冰水滴落的声音都能听见似的松林，沿着铁路走过滑雪场下方，就有坟地了。

en.t: After passing through a pine grove so quiet that one could almost hear icy water dripping, and walking along the railway below the ski slope, one came to a graveyard.

units.source_text: 在田埂稍高的一个角落里，只立着十来座旧石碑和地藏菩萨。

en.t: In a slightly raised corner of the rice-field ridge, only ten or so old stone markers and Jizo Bodhisattva statues stood.

units.source_text: 每座坟都显得十分寒碜，光秃秃的，没有鲜花。

en.t: Each grave looked terribly shabby, bare and without flowers.
